passages.note: Assembly final-passage Aye on a parental-rights bill with sixteen unrelated rights (religion, medical records, surveillance systems, discipline); earlier-chamber record of the same legislature.

passages.provision_quote: (e) The right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child while at
passages.note: Co-sponsor of the bill as introduced; the names-and-pronouns right is one of many unrelated parental rights, and no own words tie her support to that clause.

rows.reasoning: Schutt co-sponsored and voted Aye on AB 510 (2023-2024), whose section (3)(e) reserves to parents "The right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child while at" school, which points to the parental side ("Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns"). But AB 510 is a multi-subject parental-rights bill, and no statement of hers ties her vote or sponsorship to that provision, so it shows a side at most, not a rung.
